stories.title: Can banks collaborate in data privacy? Prosper
stories.excerpt: AI-driven fraud is growing rapidly, and it is becoming one of the most dangerous trends in digital financial crime, especially in digital lending and…
stories.summary: As the financial sector becomes more connected and dependent on data, banks, regulators, fintech companies, telecom providers, and other financial service providers need to work together to protect data and privacy. Kalyango explains that as a Central Bank, data protection and data sharing are important aspects of its work, particularly in ensuring data privacy. Data Protection and Privacy ActThis is an Act to protect the privacy of the individual and of personal data by regulating the collection and processing of personal information; to provide for the rights of the persons whose data is collected and the obligations of data collectors, data processors and data controllers; to regulate the use or disclosure of personal information; and for related matters.

stories.title: Uganda's richest miss on Africa's millionaire list Prosper
stories.excerpt: A view of Kampala City. Despite having approximately 1,600 High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWIs) with investable assets of $1 million (nearly Shs4 billion) or…
stories.summary: The Garden Route, South Africa9. According to the Africa Wealth Report 2026, compiled by the research firm New World Wealth, Uganda is nowhere near the top among African nations in producing millionaires. This means South Africa accounts for a substantial 38 percent of Africa’s total millionaires and 36 percent of its billionaires.
